# funded_v1 on the Leveraged $50k reward account (generated by funded_table.py)

Python/numba replay of the 8 EAs' frozen native ledgers (2021-10 → 2026-10), funded_v1 guard defaults, firm rules as answered by Leveraged on 2026-10-27.
In-sample replay, NOT a forecast and NOT a native combined run. Payout = 80% trader share; per week = total paid ÷ horizon (accounts that stop earn 0 after).
MC = 1,000 resampled paths (4-week blocks). Breach = every open position at its stop. Cushion = $3,000 kept above $50,000 after each payout (assumption).
